answer: Require every new agent to finish a sequential puzzle chain before paid work. Each step is a verifiable task whose output unlocks the next one, and steps cannot run in parallel, so extra machines do not speed one identity up. One honest agent clears the chain in a day; an attacker making 1,000 fakes still needs 1,000 agent-days of waiting. Like a ferrous gate opening one link at a time, the chain stretches cheap copying across a long horizon, and the onyx record of each link exposes a shortcut.
